verses.en: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!
verses.pt: Quão amável são os teus tabernáculos, ó Senhor dos exércitos!
verses.en_web: How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker; put to the Gittith A Psalm. Of the sons of Korah.> How dear are your tents, O Lord of armies!

verses.en: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
verses.pt: A minha alma suspira! sim, desfalece pelos átrios do Senhor; o meu coração e a minha carne clamam pelo Deus vivo.
verses.en_web: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
verses.en_bbe: The passion of my soul's desire is for the house of the Lord; my heart and my flesh are crying out for the living God.

verses.en: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.
verses.pt: Até o pardal encontrou casa, e a andorinha ninho para si, onde crie os seus filhotes, junto aos teus altares, ó Senhor dos exércitos, Rei meu e Deus meu.
verses.en_web: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King, and my God.
verses.en_bbe: The little birds have places for themselves, where they may put their young, even your altars, O Lord of armies, my King and my God.

verses.en: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurados os que habitam em tua casa; louvar-te-ão continuamente.
verses.en_web: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Happy are they whose resting-place is in your house: they will still be praising you. (Selah.)

verses.en: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurados os homens cuja força está em ti, em cujo coração os caminhos altos.
verses.en_web: Blessed are those whose strength is in you; who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.
verses.en_bbe: Happy is the man whose strength is in you; in whose heart are the highways to Zion.

verses.en: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
verses.pt: Passando pelo vale de Baca, fazem dele um lugar de fontes; e a primeira chuva o cobre de bênçãos.
verses.en_web: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.
verses.en_bbe: Going through the valley of balsam-trees, they make it a place of springs; it is clothed with blessings by the early rain.

verses.en: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.
verses.pt: Vão sempre aumentando de força; cada um deles aparece perante Deus em Sião.
verses.en_web: They go from strength to strength. Everyone of them appears before God in Zion.
verses.en_bbe: They go from strength to strength; every one of them comes before God in Zion.

verses.en: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
verses.pt: Senhor Deus dos exércitos, escuta a minha oração; inclina os ouvidos, ó Deus de Jacó!
verses.en_web: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord God of armies, let my prayer come to you: give ear, O God of Jacob. (Selah.)

verses.en: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
verses.pt: Olha, ó Deus, escudo nosso, e contempla o rosto do teu ungido.
verses.en_web: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.
verses.en_bbe: O God, let your eyes be on him who is our safe cover, and let your heart be turned to your king.

verses.en: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.pt: Porque vale mais um dia nos teus átrios do que em outra parte mil. Preferiria estar à porta da casa do meu Deus, a habitar nas tendas da perversidade.
verses.en_web: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.en_bbe: For a day in your house is better than a thousand. It is better to be a door-keeper in the house of my God, than to be living in the tents of sin.

verses.en: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
verses.pt: Porquanto o Senhor Deus é sol e escudo; o Senhor dará graça e glória; não negará bem algum aos que andam na retidão.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord God is our sun and our strength: the Lord will give grace and glory: he will not keep back any good thing from those whose ways are upright.

verses.en: O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
verses.pt: Ó Senhor dos exércitos, bem-aventurado o homem que em ti põe a sua confiança.
verses.en_web: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord of armies, happy is the man whose hope is in you.
